prompt: I have an idea for a skill around 'expense reports' but haven't thought it through much. Can you spec it out for me?

assertions.text: Skill opens with grounding/broad clarifying questions rather than jumping straight to a SPECS.md draft on the first turn
Exactly one SPECS.md and one RUBRIC.md were produced by the end (no side-by-side alternates)
Final SPECS.md is concrete and specific to whatever expense-report scenario emerged from questioning, not generic/hand-wavy
SPECS.md contains all required sections (Purpose, Trigger conditions, Inputs, Outputs, Scope & boundaries, Non-goals, Edge cases, Open assumptions)
RUBRIC.md criteria are grounded in the specific spec produced, not a generic template
No SKILL.md-style content appears anywhere in the output
